The post Inside the Modern SOC: The Identity Front Door appeared first on Unit 42.

aiSummary.summary: A Unit 42 report highlights that identity-based attacks are currently responsible for ninety percent of security incidents. The article explores how modern threat actors exploit digital identities and provides guidance for Security Operations Center leaders.
aiSummary.whyItMatters: It highlights that compromised identities are now the primary vector for the vast majority of cyber attacks, necessitating a shift in defense strategies.
aiSummary.action: Review identity and access management controls within your security operations.

aiSummary.summary: A vulnerability in the web-based management interface of Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager allows an authenticated, remote attacker to view sensitive information in clear text. This security flaw impacts the confidentiality of data on affected systems.
aiSummary.whyItMatters: It matters because authenticated attackers can exploit this flaw to harvest sensitive clear-text data from the management interface.
aiSummary.action: Apply the official security updates provided by Cisco.

items.title: From Screen Share to Root Access: Breaking Down CVE-2026-43760 and CVE-2026-65400 on macOS
items.summary: Apple’s latest macOS update addresses two vulnerabilities in its Screen Sharing server, including one that enables pre-authenticated remote code execution.

aiSummary.summary: Apple has released a macOS update to fix two vulnerabilities in the Screen Sharing server. These flaws include a critical issue that allows for pre-authenticated remote code execution leading to root access.
aiSummary.whyItMatters: Unauthenticated attackers could exploit these flaws to gain full root access to compromised macOS systems via the screen sharing service.
aiSummary.action: Update macOS to the latest version immediately.

aiSummary.summary: Around 900 users fell victim to a scam offering 90% off official Anthropic Claude AI services. These unauthorized cut-price services likely compromised user data by capturing their private interactions.

aiSummary.summary: A heap buffer overflow vulnerability has been identified in the nothings stb TrueType library up to version 1.26. This flaw is triggered when processing malformed font data and can result in a Denial of Service.
aiSummary.whyItMatters: Attackers could exploit this vulnerability to crash applications relying on the library, leading to service disruption.
